items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1958-08-08; 1958-09-03
items.q: Jackson, Will and Puff. Played Coles Lawn and played St. Couches.

ctx.x: I've heard that you all played mostly with Oregon.

Well, most during that time, when Oregon really began to get to know. We used to play lots of time out in the country, you know. Every play there was St. John, Lake Charles, Donisonville, you know. We used to play over here. We had a place to play in, uh. There was Coles Lawn. Oh, we was there for years at Coles Lawn. Coles Lawn. Jackson, Will and Puff. Played Coles Lawn and played St. Couches. We played all over there. We just kept down at the Tulane University. Those boys, a lot. They got right popular around…
Uh, she was crazy about the band.
